digest.component_or_area: CLI mutation verbs and output handling
propositions: Silent success on mutating verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, set-file-impact) is indistinguishable from no-op, causing agents to verify mutations with redundant show calls and misinterpret failures

Mutating verbs must emit one-line kubectl-style confirmations on stdout describing the action outcome with no additional store read, and print 'no change: <reason>' for idempotent no-ops, both exiting 0
Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must be normalized to a shared one-line confirmation contract preserving all existing data without information loss
Global --quiet/-q and --output/-o flags must be extracted at the top-level router before partition dispatch to work uniformly on all in-scope verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves
The link REDIRECT record must remain byte-identical on write and no-op paths including under --quiet, with no additional confirmation line added in text mode
Consumed seam return contracts (e.g. add_dependency dict|None REDIRECT) must remain unchanged and untouched by confirmation additions
